description: (0.5.0) Selecting the version for T in an as-of pass (RFC-ACDP-0020 §5.4). Behavioral, consumer-side.

input.golden: trust-001 vector 1 (tenant-acme.production, serial 7, issuer = the sig-003 did:key)

expected.behavior: Serials 6 (issued 2026-09-01) and 7 (issued 2026-10-26) known; T = 2026-10-10: serial 6 is selected even though the consumer's present floor is 7.
T = 2026-08-01, before serial 6 was issued: list_invalid (no_valid_version).
Serial 6 retracted by the issuer with an event admitted after T = 2026-10-10: the retraction does not count as of T; serial 6 is used.
Serial 6 retracted with an event admitted before T: list_invalid (retracted) as of T; serial 5 is not used.
Serial 6's valid_until is 2026-10-05 and T = 2026-10-10 with serial 7 not yet issued: expired (list_window); no fallback to serial 5 whose window covers T.

scenarios.name: G — issuer DID document as of T

expected.behavior: The issuer is did:web and rotated its key on 2026-10-20: serial 6 verifies against the DID document selected as of T per RFC-ACDP-0017 §6.2.
